services.name: Parasailing 1 Person
services.desc: Enjoy one of the most incredible experiences in Gran Canaria, parasailing over the Atlantic Ocean from Pasito Blanco. A safe, exciting activity suitable for almost everyone, where you can admire the island's southern coast from the air while gently soaring, pulled by a boat. From the air you can see the dunes of Maspalomas, Puerto Rico and the incredible color of the water in the south of Gran Canaria. No prior experience is necessary. Our professional team takes care of everything. You just have to relax and enjoy the views. The activity depends on sea and wind conditions. In case of adverse weather conditions that prevent its realization, a change of date will be offered or a refund will
